overview_description.description: Burjeel Holdings operates in the healthcare sector, providing private healthcare services. The company manages several brands including Burjeel, Medeor, LLH, Lifecare, and Tajmeel. It is known for its quality services and clinical excellence. The company also focuses on strengthening healthcare systems in emerging markets and globally. It offers a range of services and encourages potential talents to join their community for job postings and more. The company also provides various ways for customers to get in touch, including email, WhatsApp, and phone.
